label: Team 19859 concept — twin turret, hopper 4, no FLOWER scoring, back intake, mecanum. Not built: performance is a range.

aimSettle.unit: s slow before a shot releases

vFire.unit: in/s max speed while firing; 100 = unlimited

tSecure.unit: s of slow intake before capture

vIntake.unit: in/s max speed to capture; 100 = unlimited

intakeSuccess.unit: probability an intake attempt works first time

intakeRetry.unit: s lost on a failed attempt

turretYawRange.unit: deg of travel centred on home; 360 = unlimited

turretHome.unit: deg vs robot front, both turrets (shooters face front)

hpDelay.unit: s from cue to human-player entry

shotAccuracy.unit: probability a released shot lands (layer C)
